entities.name: Ainbcellach mac Ferchair
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ainbcellach mac Ferchair was king of the Cenél Loairn of Dál Riata, and perhaps of all Dál Riata, from 697 until 698, when he was deposed and exiled to Ireland.
